name: Itsukushima Hibiki
source: The only one to ever leave the island to study law. He is not fond of crossdressing and only wears female clothing when he's home. Constantly quarrels with Meguru, who is his nephew. Despite this Meguru always calls him obaa-san (aunty) because of his hatred towards crossdressing. He likes to fish and has some knowledge towards repairing ship engines. He is an underclassmen of Yukito, whom he invites to the island to study the local flora.
